provenance.note: A low formant call: the growl's operator held gentle, its mouth opening from o to a over a third of a second, a slow wobble, and a fall of a quarter-tone and more off the note at its end, a call's drop. Held a beat or two, wetter than the stab.

notes.bendCents: The call's fall at its end, over its last 0.16 s.
notes.timbres: none declared: a sketch row, held at nought (AWAITING) until his pick admits it
notes.trim: 0.49: its note at the marimba's loudness alone (0.35) and then 3 dB over, a producer's call: an octave under the front, it read 3 to 6 dB further under the mix than the other four at the same note loudness.
notes.vowelFrom: Round dark-fronts' fourth pass (his ear 11-03: 'Call a bit too quiet or sinking behind other synths … maybe we play EQ a bit to get these voices in a bit higher frequencies'): the mouth opens higher, o at 560/1250 Hz to a at 950/1750 Hz (was 380/820 to 720/1180), the floor at 380 Hz and the lid at 4.2 kHz, the breath at 2.4 kHz, so it speaks above the reese's growl and the formant pad's body (150-600 Hz).
